setting: A student is talking to a bookstore clerk about returning a textbook.
narrator_intro: Listen to a conversation between a student and a bookstore clerk.

dialogue.speaker: speaker1
dialogue.text: Hi, I bought this chemistry textbook last week, but I ended up dropping the class. Can I return it?

dialogue.speaker: speaker2
dialogue.text: Sure, as long as it's within two weeks of purchase and you have the receipt. Do you have it with you?

dialogue.speaker: speaker1
dialogue.text: I do, right here. But I already wrote some notes in the margins, is that still okay?

dialogue.speaker: speaker2
dialogue.text: That could be a problem for a full refund. If there's writing inside, we can only offer store credit, not cash back.

dialogue.speaker: speaker1
dialogue.text: Hmm, I didn't realize that. How much store credit would I get?

dialogue.speaker: speaker2
dialogue.text: Usually about seventy percent of the purchase price for a book with light markings. Let me take a look... yeah, this qualifies for that rate.

dialogue.speaker: speaker1
dialogue.text: That's better than nothing, I guess. Can I use the credit toward a different textbook today?

dialogue.speaker: speaker2
dialogue.text: Absolutely, store credit doesn't expire and can be used on anything in the store, not just textbooks.

narrator_outro: Now get ready to answer the questions.

To return a textbook he no longer needs
To ask about the store's return policy in general

questions.explanation: He explains he dropped the class and wants to return the textbook he purchased.
questions.correctAnswer: To return a textbook he no longer needs

questions.narrator_text: Why can't the student get a full cash refund?

options.text: He returned the book after the deadline
The book is a different edition than required
He wrote notes inside the book

questions.explanation: The clerk explains that writing inside the book limits him to store credit rather than a cash refund.
questions.correctAnswer: He wrote notes inside the book

questions.narrator_text: How much store credit will the student receive?

options.text: Seventy percent of the purchase price
Fifty percent of the purchase price

questions.explanation: The clerk states that light markings qualify for about seventy percent store credit.
questions.correctAnswer: Seventy percent of the purchase price

options.text: It cannot be combined with other purchases
It has flexible use and no expiration
It must be used the same day
It can only be used for textbooks

questions.correctAnswer: It has flexible use and no expiration
